column1: # Flattening texture basename renames, 1.12.2 to current.
# Format: KIND<TAB>OLD_BASENAME<TAB>NEW_BASENAME    KIND is block or item.
# Names carry no directory and no extension. The blocks/ to block/ and items/ to item/
# directory move is applied separately, so only the basename appears here.
# Derived from the 1.12.2, 1.13, and 26.2 client jars by two independent methods:
#   - identical PNG content across the 1.13 boundary, which proves a pair outright
#   - the texture a vanilla model names, before and after, for art that also changed
# The two agreed on 250 of the 251 pairs they both produced. The one disagreement,
# tallgrass, was settled on content: its pixels are byte-identical to grass.
# Every row is then checked against the 26.2 jar: the old basename must be gone and the
# new one must exist. Five textures were renamed a second time after 1.13 and are chained
# to their current name, so a pack lands on what the game actually ships:
